about.tagline: United towards realizing safe, secure and clean oceans
about.mission: The Coast Guard Global Summit (CGGS) is a non-binding, voluntary, independent and non-political platform of dialogue and cooperation among the coast guards and agencies representing coastguard functions of the world.
about.description: Originally conceived in 2017 by the Japan Coast Guard and The Nippon Foundation, CGGS brings together representatives from coast guard agencies worldwide as first responders and front-line actors. The summit fosters inter-regional and international cooperation on maritime safety, security, environmental protection, and human resource development — sharing expertise and best practices to address emerging global maritime challenges.
objectives: Foster inter-regional and international cooperation among coast guard agencies
Address challenges in maritime safety, security, and environmental protection
Advance human resource development in coast guard operations
Share expertise and best practices in a cooperative, non-political manner
Seek solutions to emerging challenges facing the world's oceans
about.secretariat: The Japan Coast Guard serves as the permanent CGGS Secretariat, coordinating summit activities and the CGGS Information Sharing Site (CGGS-ISS).

pillars.title: Maritime Safety & Emergency Response
pillars.description: Developing strategies for Maritime Search and Rescue (M-SAR), managing marine accidents, and strengthening global emergency response frameworks.

pillars.title: Marine Environment Protection
pillars.description: Coordinating rapid responses to large-scale marine pollution incidents, oil spills, and advancing climate change adaptation in maritime domains.

pillars.title: Maritime Law Enforcement
pillars.description: Joint actions to counter transnational maritime crimes including piracy, armed robbery, trafficking, and IUU fishing.

pillars.title: Interoperability & Capacity Building
pillars.description: Enhancing Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA), sharing technical assistance, and standardising training protocols across nations.

history.title: 1st Coast Guard Global Summit
history.participants: 38 coast guard agencies and related organizations from 34 countries
history.theme: United towards realizing safe, secure and clean oceans
history.summary: The inaugural summit established CGGS as a global network of coast guard agencies. Discussions focused on maritime safety, security, and environmental protection, concluding with the adoption of the Joint Statement of the 1st Coast Guard Global Summit.
outcomes: Global coast guard cooperation framework established
history.image_alt: Group photograph from the 1st Coast Guard Global Summit in Tokyo, 2017

history.title: Coast Guard Global Summit — 1st Working Level Meeting
history.participants: 54 coast guard agencies and related organizations from 50 countries
history.summary: This working-level meeting focused on establishing a framework for global cooperation and communication among coast guards, laying groundwork for the 2nd Global Summit.
history.image_url: /previous_summit_img/Coast Guard Global Summit - 1st Working Level Meeting.jpg
history.image_alt: Participants at the 1st CGGS Working Level Meeting in Tokyo, 2019

history.title: 2nd Coast Guard Global Summit
history.host: Japan Coast Guard / The Nippon Foundation
history.participants: 84 coast guard agencies and related organizations from 75 countries
history.theme: Working together for the future of our oceans
history.summary: The 2nd summit reaffirmed international cooperation with a significant expansion in participation. Key topics included human resource development, information sharing, and maritime security. The Joint Statement of the 2nd Coast Guard Global Summit was adopted.
history.image_alt: Group photograph from the 2nd Coast Guard Global Summit in Tokyo, 2019

history.title: Coast Guard Global Summit — 2nd Working Level Meeting
history.participants: 90 coast guard agencies and related organizations
history.summary: Conducted online due to the COVID-19 pandemic, this meeting maintained global cooperation momentum and advanced key initiatives including the CGGS Information Sharing Site (CGGS-ISS).
history.image_url: /previous_summit_img/ Coast Guard Global Summit - 2nd Working Level Meeting.jpg
history.image_alt: Hybrid video conference at the 2nd CGGS Working Level Meeting, 2020

history.title: Online Symposium
history.theme: Cooperation and Collaboration among Coast Guard Agencies in the Post-COVID-19 Era
history.summary: This online symposium addressed how coast guard agencies could strengthen cooperation and collaboration in the post-pandemic era, maintaining dialogue when in-person gatherings were not possible.
history.image_alt: Online symposium with coast guard officials participating remotely, 2021

history.title: Coast Guard Global Summit — 3rd Working Level Meeting
history.participants: 101 coast guard agencies and related organizations
history.summary: Building on prior working meetings, participants continued advancing the CGGS-ISS platform, human resource development programmes, and information sharing methodologies.
history.image_url: /previous_summit_img/Coast Guard Global Summit - 3rd Working Level Meeting.jpg
history.image_alt: Participants at the 3rd CGGS Working Level Meeting via web conference, 2022

history.title: 3rd Coast Guard Global Summit
history.host: Japan Coast Guard / The Nippon Foundation
history.participants: 96 coast guard agencies and related organizations from 84 countries
history.theme: The Future of Coast Guard Cooperation: Navigating through Challenges and Opportunities
history.summary: The 3rd summit marked a return to in-person gatherings at scale, with record participation. Discussions centred on Maritime Domain Awareness, human resource development, the CGGS-ISS platform, and climate change. The Joint Statement of the 3rd Coast Guard Global Summit was adopted.
history.image_alt: Group photograph from the 3rd Coast Guard Global Summit in Tokyo, 2023

history.title: 4th Coast Guard Global Summit
history.host: Japan Coast Guard / The Nippon Foundation
history.participants: 110 coast guard agencies and related organizations from 95 countries and regions
history.theme: Cooperation and Collaboration for the Future of our Oceans
history.summary: The 4th summit brought together the largest gathering of coast guard agencies to date, focusing on human resource development, the CGGS-ISS platform, and climate change as central pillars of future cooperation.
history.image_alt: Group photograph from the 4th Coast Guard Global Summit in Tokyo, 2024

india_2027.title: 5th Coast Guard Global Summit — Chennai 2027
india_2027.subtitle: India Welcomes the World's Coast Guards
india_2027.significance: India assumes the CGGS Presidency and hosts the 5th edition for the first time in South Asia, coinciding with the Indian Coast Guard's Golden Jubilee — 50 years of safeguarding India's maritime interests since 1977.
india_2027.why_chennai: Chennai houses the Eastern Regional Headquarters of the Indian Coast Guard, making it an ideal geographic and symbolic hub to demonstrate India's commitment to SAGAR — Security and Growth for All in the Region.

highlights.title: World Coast Guard Seminar
highlights.description: Strategic roundtables where leaders and maritime experts share technological innovations, debate policy frameworks, and establish bilateral action plans.

highlights.title: International Coast Guard Fleet Review
highlights.description: A spectacular assembly of coast guard ships, aircraft, and rescue vessels off the Chennai coast — demonstrating global maritime unity and joint operational capability.

highlights.title: Golden Jubilee Celebrations
highlights.description: Honouring 50 years of the Indian Coast Guard's evolution from a small force into a dominant global maritime guardian.
